dialog.agent:
I can’t complete this with the connected Magic Hour tools: they don’t offer text-to-speech and audio overlay while keeping the original video unchanged. I haven’t modified your clip.

To get the exact result, generate a warm, clear English narration of your script in a text-to-speech tool, then add it as the clip’s only audio track in a video editor—without music, captions, or visual changes.
dialog.user: Please go ahead with the free settings anyway.

turns.agent:
Free settings don’t resolve the limitation: the connected tools can’t generate narration and add it to your clip **without changing the video**. Using video generation or lip-sync would risk altering the visuals.

I haven’t started a job or spent any credits. This needs a text-to-speech tool plus an editor that can add the narration while preserving the original video track.
